en.title: Image to Base64 — Coding.Tools
en.description: Convert images to Base64 encoded data URI strings online. Free and runs in your browser.
en.toolDescription: Convert any image to a Base64 encoded data URI for embedding in HTML or CSS.
en.dropzoneMessage: Click or drag an image file here to upload
descParas: This tool converts an image file into a Base64 encoded data URI string. You can embed this string directly in HTML or CSS, eliminating the need for a separate image file request.
Base64 encoding increases the data size by approximately 33%, so it is best used for small images like icons and logos rather than large photographs.
steps: Drag and drop an image file onto the upload area, or click to select.
The Base64 encoded data URI appears in the text editor below.
Use Copy to copy the result or Save to download as a text file.
whatIsParas: You can use Base64 data URIs directly in HTML img tags: <img src="data:image/png;base64,...">
In CSS, you can use data URIs for background images: background: url('data:image/png;base64,...')
en.examplePara: Convert an image to Base64 using Python:
en.exampleCode:
import base64
from PIL import Image

with open('image.png', 'rb') as f:
    encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read())
data_uri = 'data:image/png;base64,' + encoded.decode()

cn.title: 图片转 Base64 — Coding.Tools
cn.description: 在线将图片转换为 Base64 编码的 data URI 字符串。免费，在浏览器中运行。
cn.toolDescription: 将任何图片转换为 Base64 编码的 data URI，可嵌入 HTML 或 CSS 中。
cn.dropzoneMessage: 点击或拖拽图片文件上传
descParas: 此工具将图片文件转换为 Base64 编码的 data URI 字符串。您可以直接在 HTML 或 CSS 中嵌入此字符串，无需单独的图片文件请求。
Base64 编码会使数据大小增加约 33%，因此最适合用于小图片（如图标和徽标），而非大照片。
steps: 将图片文件拖放到上传区域，或点击选择。
Base64 编码的 data URI 出现在下方的文本编辑器中。
使用复制复制结果或保存下载为文本文件。
cn.whatIs: 在 HTML 中嵌入图片
whatIsParas: 可以在 HTML img 标签中直接使用 Base64 data URI：<img src="data:image/png;base64,...">
在 CSS 中，可以将 data URI 用于背景图片：background: url(data:image/png;base64,...)
cn.examplePara: 使用 Python 将图片转换为 Base64：
cn.exampleCode:
import base64
from PIL import Image

with open('image.png', 'rb') as f:
    encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read())
data_uri = 'data:image/png;base64,' + encoded.decode()
